note: Agent testers (docs/AGENT_TESTER.md), named john0002, john0003, and so on (user decision of 2026-11-14). Each is one synthetic writer: fixed habits drawn from its seed, and two traits. precision: high = ink close to the ideal geometry, low = careless. consistency: high = habits nearly the same at every drawing, low = habits drawn anew at every drawing. The label in its entries is the first 8 hex digits of the SHA-256 of 'agent-' + name; that code opens only the page served locally by tools/agent_tester.js, not the live site. rotation: one tester per day, in this order, counted from epoch. To add a tester: a new name and seed here and in the rotation. Never reuse a name, and never change the seed or traits of a tester that has run (its entries would no longer match its record). From ink 0.5.0 (request R4): pointer (pen, touch, mouse) = the pointer type whose ink of people (data/ink_profile.json) the tester's copies follow; hand = share of the atoms other than carbon (and of the negative charges) written by hand with samples of people (data/letter_samples.json). john0002 to john0005 have neither and left the rotation on 2026-11-26.
